There is no impurity in the rain, which falls at all places.
7N1U: Impurity does not come from the earth; impurity does not come from the water.
There is no impurity in the earth, nor there is any impurity in the water.
ਧਰਤੀ (ਦਾ ਰਟਨ ਕਰਨ) ਨਾਲ ਜਾਂ ਗੁਫ਼ਾ ਆਦਿਕ ਬਣਾਣ ਨਾਲ
ਪਾਣੀ (ਵਿਚ ਖਲੋ ਕੇ ਤਪ ਕਰਨ) ਨਾਲ
2HMW: Impurity does not come from the air which is diffused everywhere.
No impurity is contained in the air too.
3GNN: O Nanak, the one who has no Guru, has no redeeming virtues at all.
Nanak, there is no virtue, in the man, without the Guru.
ਉਹਨਾਂ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਜੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਦੱਸੇ ਰਸਤੇ ਉਤੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਤੁਰਦੇ
HRLM: Impurity comes from turning one's face away from God. ||1||
Nanak, turning away one's face from the Lord, the mouth is defiled.
4F4M: O Nanak, the mouth is truly cleansed by ritual cleansing, if you really know how to do it.
Nanak, pure is the mouthful of water, if some one fully knows how to gargle it.
ਚੁਲੀ ਭਰਨੀ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੋਵੇ, ਚੁਲੀ ਭਰਨ ਦੀ ਸਮਝ ਹੋਵੇ
1PNB: For the intuitively aware, cleansing is spiritual wisdom. For the Yogi, it is self-control.
For the man of wisdom of mouthful is of the gnosis and for the yogi of chastity.
JKNW: For the Brahmin, cleansing is contentment; for the householder, it is truth and charity.
For the Brahman, the mouthful is of contentment and for the householder the truth and charity.
2YTQ: For the king, cleansing is justice; for the scholar, it is true meditation.
For the King the mouthful is of justice and for the learned man of the true reflection.
CVQG: The consciousness is not washed with water; you drink it to quench your thirst.
With water, the mind is washed not, but by drinking it with mouth, one's thirst is quenched.
N9XK: Water is the father of the world; in the end, water destroys it all. ||2||
The water is the birth-giver of creation and ultimately the water destroys it all.
ਨਾਸ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ; ਪਰਲੌ ਦਾ ਕਾਰਨ ਬਣਦਾ ਹੈ
9JL8: Hearing the Name, all supernatural spiritual powers are obtained, and wealth follows along.
Hearing the Name, all the supernatural powers are obtained and wealth follows the mortal.
43FC: Hearing the Name, the nine treasures are received, and the mind's desires are obtained.
Hearing the Lord's Name, man is blest with nine treasures and obtains his heart desired boons.
ਨੌ ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨੇ (ਭਾਵ, ਜਗਤ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਪਦਾਰਥ)
D960: Hearing the Name, contentment comes, and Maya meditates at one's feet.
Hearing the Name, one earns contentment and mammon worships one's feet.
CS9J: Hearing the Name, intuitive peace and poise wells up.
Hearing the Name, poise wells up and one easily obtains peace.
M7K2: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained; O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||7||
By the Guru's instruction, God's Name is attained and the mortal sings His praises.
C6NZ: In pain, we are born; in pain, we die. In pain, we deal with the world.
In pain, man is born, in pain he dies and in pain, he deals with the world.
FA38: Hereafter, there is said to be pain, only pain; the more the mortals read, the more they cry out.
Pain and pain, he is said to suffer hereafter the more he reads and utters, the more he wails.
ਅੱਗੇ ਅੱਗੇ, ਸਾਹਮਣੇ, ਜਿਉਂ ਜਿਉਂ ਦਿਨ ਗੁਜ਼ਰਦੇ ਹਨ
M7QG: The packages of pain are untied, but peace does not emerge.
For him the packages of pain are united and no comfort emerges out of them.
01SX: In pain, the soul burns; in pain, it departs weeping and wailing.
In pain, the mortal burns and in pain he departs wailing.
LYGS: O Nanak, imbued with the Lord's Praise, the mind and body blossom forth, rejuvenated.
Imbued with the Lord's praise, O Nanak, one's soul and body are reverdured.
SY1P: In the fire of pain, the mortals die; but pain is also the cure. ||1||
With the fire of pain, the mortals are scorched to death, but pain is also the cure of all ills.
44MQ: O Nanak, worldly pleasures are nothing more than dust. They are the dust of the dust of ashes.
Nanak, the worldly revelments are but dust, They are altogether dust of dust and ashes.
7WW3: The mortal earns only the dust of the dust; his body is covered with dust.
The dust of dust, the mortal earns and with dust, he soils his body.
VN9G: When the soul is taken out of the body, it too is covered with dust.
When the soul is taken out of the body m it goes, sated with the dust of sins.
6T6M: And when one's account is called for in the world hereafter, he receives only ten times more dust. ||2||
Hereafter, when the mortal is asked the account, he receives ten times the more dust.
(ਪੂਰਬ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਰਦੰਤਕ, Locative Absolute) ਜਦੋਂ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਦਾ ਹੈ
RG84: Hearing the Name, one is blessed with purity and self-control, and the Messenger of Death will not draw near.
Hearing the Lord's Name, man is blessed with purity and self-control and death's courier comes not near him.
ਇੰਦ੍ਰਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਚੰਗੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਵੱਸ ਵਿਚ ਲਿਆਉਣਾ
M051: Hearing the Name, the heart is illumined, and darkness is dispelled.
Hearing the Lord's Name, one mind is illumined and one's darkness is dispelled.
1TCY: Hearing the Name, one comes to understand his own self, and the profit of the Name is obtained.
Hearing the Lord's name, one realises one's ownself and attains the profit of the Name.
N6R7: Hearing the Name, sins are eradicated, and one meets the Immaculate True Lord.
Hearing the Lord's Name, the sins are washed off and one meets with the Immaculate True Lord.
7WFQ: O Nanak, hearing the Name, one's face becomes radiant. As Gurmukh, meditate on the Name. ||8||
O Nanak, hearing the Lord's Name, man's countenance becomes bright, It is through the Guru's grace, that he contemplates the Name.
ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਦੱਸੇ ਰਾਹ ਉਤੇ ਤੁਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ
GQCT: In your home, is the Lord God, along with all your other gods.
In your house, you keep the idol of God, with all other gods.
